WITH annulees AS (
               UPDATE programme.sessions
                  SET status = 'cancelled',
                      cancelled_reason = jsonb_build_object('fr', $2::text)
                WHERE proposal_id = $1
                  AND published_at IS NOT NULL
                  AND status::text = ANY($3)
            RETURNING id
           )
           SELECT count(*) AS "n!" FROM annulees
